name: Ratree Srisuk
bio:
Ratree Srisuk's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. After a career in supply chain management for a large agricultural firm, a chance encounter with a struggling racing team led her to offer her expertise in logistics. Her innate ability to streamline operations and optimize resource allocation quickly made her indispensable. Ratree approaches her role with meticulous precision, ensuring every component, spare part, and piece of equipment arrives exactly when and where it's needed. 

She joined Caterham Motorsport five years ago and has since revolutionized their supply chain. Known for her uncanny ability to anticipate potential logistical bottlenecks, Ratree's foresight has saved the team valuable time and resources. While collaborative in principle, she prefers working independently, meticulously crafting her plans and executing them with unwavering focus, often consulting technical data directly.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly tied back in a low ponytail with a few strands framing her face.
physical.description: Ratree has a focused and observant gaze that reflects her sharp mind.

quirks: Always carries a meticulously organized notebook filled with logistics flowcharts.
Insists on personally inspecting every shipment, regardless of size.
Has an uncanny ability to predict weather patterns affecting transportation routes.
